subject: Request: one-time 'usage floor' credit for DataHaven pilot — VP/CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-10 09:15 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time 'usage floor' credit for DataHaven pilot — VP/CFO signoff needed

Team,

Quick summary: DataHaven (trial pilot, DH-2026-PILOT-01) has underutilized the pilot month due to delayed onboarding and an integration bug on their side. They are a high-priority prospect (platform buyer + embedded ML roadmap), and Vivek is asking for a one-time "usage floor" credit to preserve momentum and convert to a paid roll-out.

Request: approve a one-time credit of $8,250 to be applied as an invoice adjustment against the pilot month (not a recurring rate change). Credit rationale and structure below. I need explicit VP/CFO sign-off to proceed.

Why:
- Original pilot committed TCV (annualized) projection: $180k ARR, pilot month forecasted consumption: $18k. Actual recorded usage: $3.6k (see attached pilot_usage_report_oct2026.csv).
- Customer is asking for a make-good to cover a minimum spend floor through the first paid month because onboarding delays impacted their evaluation timeline.

Proposed options (pick one):
1) One-time usage-floor credit of $8,250 (covers shortfall to 50% of forecasted pilot month). Applied as negative line item on next invoice. No contract amendment to list prices.
2) One-time $11,000 credit in exchange for a 6-month term extension added to the SOW (amendment required).
3) Deny credit; offer enhanced onboarding credits (CS hours) instead.

Recommendation (mine): Option 1. Preserves list price, keeps paperwork minimal, gives customer a path to convert quickly.

Attachments: DataHaven_SOW_v1.pdf, pilot_usage_report_oct2026.csv, redwood-exception-memo-draft.docx.

If you approve, please reply with either: "APPROVED: Option 1" or "APPROVED: Option 2 (with amendment)". If you need tweaks to wording, I'll push the final memo to legal and ops after sign-off.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Strategic Deals, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DataHaven_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: pilot_usage_report_oct2026.csv (CSV)]
[Attachment: redwood-exception-memo-draft.docx (DOCX)]

+1 to Mina's recommendation. A few quick data points from my side to add color for the record:
- DataHaven execs (Alicia Monroe) confirmed they want to convert to a paid deployment by EOY but need a clean evaluation month to brief their board.
- The underusage was driven by a Type-B connector bug in week 1 (we identified it, they fixed, documented in the usage CSV).
- They asked explicitly for a single invoice credit to avoid re-negotiating list price internally.

If we can do Option 1 today, I will:
- Send a brief note to Alicia that we've approved the credit and it will appear on their next invoice.
- Fast-track the onboarding check-in and schedule an integration SDR-led session next week.

This is time-sensitive — they indicated an internal board review next Thursday. Happy to jump on a quick 10-minute call if helpful.

Vivek
Director, Enterprise Sales

Attachments for this message: amendment_proposed.pdf (if we choose Option 2) and the updated memo (same doc name as earlier but versioned).
